description: This file provides utility functions for copying text to the clipboard, including a fallback method using a temporary textarea element and the primary method leveraging the Clipboard API.

methods.name: fallbackCopyTextToClipboard
methods.description: Creates a temporary textarea element to select and copy the provided text to the clipboard using document.execCommand('copy').

methods.name: copyTextToClipboard
methods.description: Attempts to copy text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API; falls back to fallbackCopyTextToClipboard if the API is unavailable.
